ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. There is a $75 per student flat fee to cover course materials. No textbook is required. The course tuition will be covered by FCAE. Student is responsible for repayment of the tuition to FCAE if the course is not successfully completed. There will be NO EXTENSIONS given for the course. Software will be provided, software and course will run on dial-up and broadband connections, however, students will need to have an external computer microphone. A course packet will be mailed to the student after registration only, so timely registration is encouraged.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign Miscellaneous Fees $75.00 Flat Fee.
